name: basilisk
title_zh: 把任意代码仓库变成可对话的活文档
tagline_zh: 别再翻 README 和散落的注释了。装了这个 skill，直接问仓库「这个函数为什么这么写」。
tagline_en: Stop digging through READMEs and scattered comments. Ask the repo 'why is this function written this way' and get.
why_zh: 它不靠向量检索猜答案，而是顺着调用图和符号定义做图遍历，回答自带文件:行号证据链。
why_en: No fuzzy vector search—it walks the call graph and symbol definitions, returning answers with file:line evidence chains. Like a.
limit_zh: 只对本地已 clone 的仓库生效，且要求仓库有完整的 git 历史；不处理二进制、锁文件或超过 10 万行的巨型仓库。
limit_en: Works only on locally cloned repos with full git history; ignores binaries, lockfiles, and repos over 100k lines; answers code facts only—no.
